meta.title: Sweet Lab — Kitchen Orders
meta.description: Production ordering for the dessert lab's shops and cafés

common.offline: You're offline. Changes won't be saved until the connection is back.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Sign in to manage your orders
auth.noAccount: Accounts are created by the lab's admin team. Contact them to open an account for your shop.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@shop.com
errors.inactiveAccount: This account isn't active yet. Contact the lab's admin team to activate it.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

home.liveHint: Numbers update automatically on every change
home.emptyCustomer: No orders yet. Your shop's first order starts from “New order”.
home.emptyStaff: No orders in these statuses right now.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.body: Order form: pick products, quantities and a delivery date, with unavailable slots and double submits blocked.

myOrders.title: My orders
myOrders.body: Live status for every order, plus one-tap reorder of past orders.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: Approve, reject or send orders back for changes, with a full history of every change.

products.title: Products
products.body: Arabic and English names, unit, minimum quantity, prep time and daily capacity.

customers.title: Customers
customers.body: Shops and cafés, their branches and staff accounts.

users.title: Users
users.body: Create accounts, assign roles and activate them. Super admins only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Same-day cutoff time, closed days, delivery windows and how far ahead orders can be placed.

kitchen.title: Kitchen board
kitchen.body: Approved orders arrive here instantly: acknowledge, start production, mark ready and delivered.

planner.title: Production plan
planner.body: Quantities grouped by product and day, with each customer's details one tap away.

pages.nextPhase: This screen is built in phase two. Its database and permissions are ready now.

errors.ERR_FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this
errors.ERR_DATE_TOO_FAR: That date is beyond the booking window
errors.ERR_DATE_CLOSED: The lab is closed on that day
errors.ERR_CUTOFF_PASSED: Today's order cutoff has passed. Choose tomorrow or later
errors.ERR_TOO_MANY_ITEMS: Too many products in one order
errors.ERR_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT: A product appears twice. Change its quantity instead
errors.ERR_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: One of the products is no longer available
errors.ERR_QUANTITY_BELOW_MIN: Quantity is below the product's minimum
errors.ERR_QUANTITY_STEP: Quantity doesn't match the product's order step
errors.ERR_LEAD_TIME: This product needs more prep time. Choose a later date
errors.ERR_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Production capacity for that day is full for one of the products
errors.ERR_REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED: Couldn't send the order. Try again
errors.ERR_ORDER_LOCKED: This order can't be edited in its current status
errors.ERR_STALE_REVISION: Someone just changed this order. Refresh to see the latest version
errors.ERR_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order can't move to that status
errors.ERR_CHANGE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: This order has a new change. Acknowledge it first
errors.ERR_CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You can't change your own role or deactivate yourself
errors.ERR_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: At least one super admin must remain
